name: Globed Room Addons
description: Extra owner-only mods for Globed rooms. They only turn on when everyone in the room has this mod installed.

room-addons-enabled.name: Room Addons Enabled (Owner Switch)
room-addons-enabled.description: The owner's master switch for room addons. Even when ON, addons stay locked until the hidden check proves everyone in the room has this mod.

auto-check.name: Auto-Check Room
auto-check.description: Automatically run the hidden has-the-mod check when you create/join a room as owner and whenever a player joins or leaves.

owner-notifications.name: Owner Notifications
owner-notifications.description: Show the room owner a small notification when room addons get unlocked or locked.

check-timeout.name: Check Timeout (seconds)
check-timeout.description: How long the owner waits for hidden replies before deciding a player does not have the mod.

open-panel-kb.name: Open Room Addons Panel
open-panel-kb.description: Opens the owner panel. The panel only does anything if you are the owner of a Globed room.

sync-restart-kb.name: Sync Restart Everyone
sync-restart-kb.description: Owner only, and only when room addons are unlocked: restarts the level for everyone in the room who has this mod, at the same time.
